caption: Erasmus Bridge, Rotterdam
composition: North-bank view of the white asymmetric pylon over the Nieuwe Maas · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the north bank of the Nieuwe Maas, the white Erasmus Bridge crosses the river with its single bent pylon and fanning cables. The deck and the water lead the eye, and the city stays behind the span. It is clear, about 22.0°C, with wind near 8.6 km/h. Late-afternoon sun warms the white steel.
